title: Turkish Potato Burek Spiral
subtitle: with caramelised onion and garlic
description: Layers of olive-oil-brushed phyllo are rolled around a spiced potato and fried onion filling, coiled into a spiral and baked until golden. Served with vegetables and boiled eggs.

steps.text: Fry the onion until golden. Add the garlic, fry for a minute and set aside to cool.
Mash the cooked potatoes to a puree. Add the fried onion and the oil from the pan, and plenty of salt and black pepper. Mix and cool.
Brush a sheet of phyllo with olive oil. Place a second sheet on top and brush that too.
Place a fifth of the filling along the edge of the sheet and roll up. Coil the resulting strip into a spiral and place in a round tin lined with baking paper.
Continue with the remaining phyllo sheets, extending the spiral in a circle.
Brush the spiral with olive oil or beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake for 25 minutes, or until browned. Serve with vegetables and hard-boiled eggs.
